note: v1507: Konyo: so much black space in the middle here, make it stretched, use the entire console. Measured with Sessions visible: zones one THE HUNT and two THE MISSIONS hold a single card each and it sat at 49 percent of a two column grid, so the right half of both movements was empty black beneath a banner that spanned the full width. The grid is correct when a zone has several cards to pair; it was only wrong when there was nothing to pair with. A card that is both the second child and the last child is by definition the only one, and now spans. Re-measured: 49 percent to 100 percent in both zones, with the paired zone untouched.
